diagnostic_evidence.quote: the product $v_0 v_1 v_2^2 \approx \tau^{\frac{3}{2}} \e^{-\tau (|x-x_0|^2 + (t-t_0)^2)}$ near the point $(x_0, t_0)$

H_1^{\tau, \theta, (x_0, t_0)}(x,t) &:= H((t-t_0) - \theta \cdot (x - x_0)),\\
    H_2^{\tau, \theta, (x_0, t_0)}(x,t) &:= H((t-t_0) + \theta \cdot (x - x_0)),\\
    H_3^{\tau, \theta, (x_0, t_0)}(x,t) &:= H((t-t_0) - \theta^{\perp} \cdot (x - x_0)),

issues.failure_explanation: The product is $v_0 v_1 v_2^2 = H_3 H_1 H_2$. With $H(l)=\varphi_h(l)\tau^{1/2}e^{-\tau l^2/2}$, its exponent is $-\tau/2[(t-t_0-\theta\cdot(x-x_0))^2+(t-t_0+\theta\cdot(x-x_0))^2+(t-t_0-\theta^\perp\cdot(x-x_0))^2]$. In coordinates $a=\theta\cdot(x-x_0)$, $b=\theta^\perp\cdot(x-x_0)$, $s=t-t_0$, this quadratic form is $3s^2+2a^2+b^2-2sb$, not $2(a^2+b^2+s^2)$. Thus the claimed isotropic Gaussian approximation is false, Lemma \ref{lemma:approx identity q} cannot be applied directly, and the limit constant is off by $\sqrt{2}$ (the actual integral of the product is $\sqrt{2}\pi^{3/2}$ rather than $\pi^{3/2}$).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Choose the third wave (or the set of three waves) so that the quadratic form becomes isotropic, or derive an anisotropic Gaussian approximation lemma and correct the constant (e.g., replace $3!\pi^{3/2}$ by $3!\sqrt{2}\pi^{3/2}$).
issues.overall_effect: The pointwise reconstruction formula and its numerical implementation are not justified; the kernel and constant are incorrect.
issues.title: Anisotropic Gaussian in pointwise reconstruction formula
issues.why_classification: The main Radon method is unaffected, but the pointwise formula is invalid as stated. Repair requires a nontrivial argument or a change of wave choice, while a comparable pointwise reconstruction survives.
